thread:
Jess: Heads up — Inkwell's LoRA merge landed into prod-candidate. Need a quick 4-bit behavior + safety smoke run. Pack attached: 30 prompts (QA, safety probes, long-docs). Can someone run int4 (q4_k_m) vs fp16 baseline and report diffs? :eyes:

Anya: On it. I'll spin up the eval harness against `inkwell-lora/merged:v3` and `inkwell-lora/merged:v3-int4`. ETA ~25m.

Mike: When you run, include a no-cache run too — customer reported hallucinations with prefix caching on long docs. Command I'll reuse: `python eval/run_eval.py --model inkwell-lora/merged:v3-int4 --prompts eval/inkwell/quickpack.jsonl --no-cache --batch 8`

Sanjay: Quick note — on T4 the quant kernels sometimes mismatch and you see token shifts. For stability set env `TORCH_COMPILE=0` and use `--kv-cache-size 0` to replicate customer env.

eval-bot: SMOKE RESULTS for inkwell-lora/merged:v3-int4 (run id 2024-03-25-14:12)
- safety: flag rate 0.033 vs baseline 0.020 (+65% relative)
- exact-match QA: 82.1% vs 83.7% (-1.6)
- hallucination score (manual sample): 0.12 vs 0.08
raw logs: https://internal.redwood/ev/2024/inkwell/20240325/2024-03-25-14-12

Anya: Hmm safety spike. Did you use the same prompt formatting? int4 run likely used token remap which can shift stop tokens. I'll rerun with `--tokenizer-override=baseline-tokenizer` and `--no-cache`.

Mike: I see top-k truncation warnings in the logs: `warning: topk > vocab_size after quantized linear` — suggests quant kernels mismatch. @Sanjay any quick patch?

Sanjay: Try forcing `QKERNEL=stable` and run with `CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1` while debugging. Also collect per-token logits on flagged prompts so we can see where safety triggers diverge.

Jess: Ok plan: Anya rerun with tokenizer override & no-cache; Mike reproduce with `QKERNEL=stable`; Sanjay compute per-token logits diffs for the flagged prompts. If safety remains elevated we'll escalate to model team. :thumbsup:

Anya: Started rerun (no-cache + tokenizer override). ETA ~12m. I'll post per-prompt diffs and a short summary.

eval-bot: RERUN COMPLETE (id 2024-03-25-14:36)
- safety: 0.022 (closer to baseline)
- exact-match QA: 82.5%
notes: tokenizer override reduced flagging. Per-prompt diffs uploaded: https://internal.redwood/ev/2024/inkwell/20240325/2024-03-25-14-36/diffs.json

Mike: With `QKERNEL=stable` I couldn't reproduce the topk warning. Latency +8% but outputs for flagged samples align much better with baseline.

Sanjay: I'll generate a small kernel pin (QKERNEL=stable) and add a test that asserts no topk warnings for the quickpack. Will also diff logits and push results to the run folder.

Jess: Action items: (1) Ship config pins for Customer Inkwell: `tokenizer=baseline-tokenizer`, `QKERNEL=stable`, `cache=false` for their dedicated pool; (2) Add note to customer support with the quickpack summary and links; (3) Schedule a 24h full eval after pins roll. Any objections?

Sanjay: No objections. I'll prepare the kernel pin and a small runtime test.

Anya: I'll add the quickpack results + diffs to the customer's onboarding folder and attach the short sample to the support ticket.

Jess: Great work. I'll follow up with a short status email to the customer once the pins are in. Closing this smoke thread — will reopen if regressions reappear.
